tool_input.command: for f in package.json pigment.app.json index.html vite.config.ts README.md .gitignore src/main.tsx src/App.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/data/*.ts src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done; ls; ls node_modules | head -50

$files = 'package.json','pigment.app.json','index.html','vite.config.ts','README.md','.gitignore','src/main.tsx','src/App.tsx','src/components/BarChart.tsx','src/components/Layout.tsx','src/components/ProjectsTable.tsx','src/components/StatusPill.tsx','src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx','src/pages/OverviewPage.tsx','src/pages/ProjectDetailPage.tsx','src/pages/ProjectsPage.tsx','src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx','src/pages/TeamPage.tsx','src/data/metrics.ts','src/data/projects.ts','src/data/team.ts','src/styles/base.css','tests/smoke.spec.ts'; foreach ($f in $files) { "=== $f"; Get-Content -Raw $f }; Get-ChildItem -Name; Get-ChildItem node_modules -Name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 80
